chunks: This is indeed the glorious Qur'an

key_terms.قُرْآنٌ: The Holy Book revealed to Prophet Muhammad

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Quran Majid' signify about the nature of the Islamic scripture?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Qur'an's intrinsic purity and divine preservation, distinguishing it from the corrupted texts of previous scriptures. It affirms the Qur'an as the ultimate criterion (Al-Furqan) and a source of spiritual nobility, reinforcing the Imams' role in elucidating its deeper, esoteric meanings.
